contents.text: What does a new supplier need before Contoso can buy from it?

A new supplier needs to be qualified after a quality audit and a credit check. A new supplier needs to be approved by the approver, the plant controller, and the CFO for orders above 250,000 USD. A new supplier needs to sign a contract with Contoso, including the supplier contract SC-2024-118. A new supplier needs to be approved by an approver other than the requester for orders up to 25,000 USD.

Supplier contract SC-2024-118: Fabrikam Seals › 3 Delivery
## 3 Delivery
The supplier delivers to the Contoso plant named in each order, carriage paid.
Late deliveries earn the buyer a credit of 1 percent of the order value per week of delay, up to 10 percent.

Supplier contract SC-2024-118: Fabrikam Seals › 1 Parties
## 1 Parties
This supply agreement is made between Contoso Industrial (the buyer) and Fabrikam Seals (the supplier).
Each party signs through an authorized representative.

Procurement policy PROC-POL-007: Purchase approvals
# Procurement policy PROC-POL-007: Purchase approvals
Every purchase order needs an approver other than the requester.
Orders above 25,000 USD need a second approval from the plant controller, and orders above 250,000 USD need the CFO's approval.
Buy only from qualified suppliers.
A new supplier is qualified after a quality audit and a credit check, and Procurement re-qualifies each supplier every three years.
Approval limits
| Order value | Approvals needed |
|---|---|
| Up to 25,000 USD | One approver other than the requester |
| 25,000 to 250,000 USD | The approver and the plant controller |
| Above 250,000 USD | The approver, the plant controller and the CFO |
Splitting an order to stay under an approval limit is a breach of this policy.
Emergency orders outside working hours may be placed by the duty manager and approved on the next business day.
